reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 8, 2026-08-01

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency requires 2-3 digit × 1-digit and 2-4 digit × leading-digit-only multiplication 'with and without regrouping', but every 1-digit multiplier shown is 0 or 1 (90×1, 17×0, 75×0, 51×0, 10×1, 25×0) -- never 2 through 9 -- so no sample can require regrouping at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The 'with regrouping' sub-case is entirely absent, and genuine non-trivial 1-digit multipliers (2-9) never appear across all 7 samples.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: 'What is 17 × 0?' and '10 × 1 = 11. True or False?' are trivial identity/zero-property facts, well below the reasoning demand of genuine 2-3 digit by 1-digit multiplication with carrying expected at grade 3 quarter 3.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Seed 46 ('What is 11 × 10?') correctly instantiates the 'leading-digit-only-nonzero' multiplier type named by the competency, but the 2-3 digit by 1-digit type never rises above ×0/×1, so genuine variant coverage across both named multiplication types is incomplete.

competency_alignment.rationale: The sampled variation is confined to the zero/identity properties, which belong to sibling node mat_g3_na_q3_1's competency, rather than the regrouping-focused multiplication this node is supposed to test.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency states 'products up to 10 000', but the products observed are 90, 0, 0, 0, 110, and (claimed) 25, all far short -- the largest genuine product (110) is roughly 1% of the stated ceiling.
